About
About Cajun Town Cafe

Cajun Town Café, located at 6476 W Little York Rd in Houston, TX, offers a cozy and inviting dining experience that highlights the rich flavors of authentic Cajun cuisine. The restaurant has built a reputation for its fresh, flavorful dishes, with menu options so consistently satisfying that almost any choice is a safe bet. House specialties are a popular highlight, as is the grilled salmon topped with the #5 selection, while stuffed crab is a seasonal treat available upon request. Guests can expect generous portions, ensuring a hearty and fulfilling meal, all at very reasonable prices. The café operates from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. on most days, except Mondays when it remains closed, and while lunch seems to be a favorite mealtime for many, the flexible hours make it accessible for a variety of visits. The ordering process is straightforward-patrons place their orders at the counter, and friendly staff deliver the food to the table, often within about ten minutes. In addition to classic Cajun entrees, the café has recently refreshed its space with remodeling, adding new menu items such as appetizers and desserts that complement the traditional offerings. Diners often note the warm and attentive service, contributing to a welcoming atmosphere that suits both family gatherings and casual outings with friends. The combination of flavorful food, attentive service, and a comfortable, remodeled interior makes the café a standout option for those craving genuine Cajun cuisine without compromising on quality or value.

Reviews

“ Their grilled chicken sandwich is great. It's a big sandwich and the grilled chicken is well seasoned and juicy. It's just as good as when I was a kid. ”

Isaias Medina

“ This place is a hidden gem. I'll be visiting whenever I'm in the area. We had the fried fish, shrimp and chicken. Red beans and rice, cajun dirty rice and onion rings.. everything was delicious and tasted like it came hot outta my mom's kitchen ”

Bianca NM

“ Cajun Town food is awesome! Throw a dart at the menu and you can't go wrong with your selection. I personally recommend the house specialties or the grilled salmon with #5 toping. If you like stuffed crab it is delicious however you need to ask if they have it available when you go, as they don't have it as part of their regular menu. You walk up to the counter to place the order and the friendly waiters bring your food to the table in about 10 minutes. Lunch is the only time I've come to eat here. Don't plan on visiting on Monday as they are closed, but open any other day from 11am-7:00pm (open later on some days). ”

Micky Petersen

“ I visited Cajun Town Café and was truly impressed. The food was delicious, fresh, and full of authentic Cajun flavor. The service was very friendly and attentive, specially Dinora, she is very friendly, making the experience even more enjoyable. The atmosphere is cozy, perfect for both family outings and gatherings with friends. The portions are generous and the prices are very reasonable for the quality they offer. Definitely a place I will return to and highly recommend to anyone who wants to enjoy great food and excellent service. ”

Patricia Rangel

“ The red beans and rice with a sausage link was pretty dang good! The atmosphere isn’t fancy, but it’s clean and well kept. Food was good. Nice guy behind the counter. Price was good for me! $16 for drink and the Red beans & rice with link. Check this place out. ”

projectomni

“ I recently RE-discovered this place and I am so happy I did. They cleaned and remodeled based on my memory from many years ago. The food is fresh and delicious and they have some new interesting items including appetizers and deserts. Portions are large and work the price. ”

Rosa Sanchez

“ The cafe is a small space with a home cooked feel. This was my first time eating here, but not my last. I was totally over dressed for the occasion. With the size of my plate, I definitely needed to be in some sweats. The food was hot, fresh, and seasoned very well. ”

Samantha Checotah
